headline: SDP @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.31 at MIL 4.80, with a projected total of 8.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: SDP moved -0.77 runs while MIL moved +0.16, changing the projected margin by -0.93 runs. The projected total fell -0.60, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brandon Sproat has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brice Turang, Jake Bauers, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ramón Laureano, Gavin Sheets because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
